blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving with options for video/photo packages and a no-wait 'Red Carpet' option. They also offer an Accelerated Freefall (AFF) student program to learn to skydive solo and earn a license. The center provides parachute rigging, inspection, repacking, and repair services by an FAA Master Parachute Rigger.
